mapper.select: SELECT m.*, l.LAWYER_ID, l.LICENSE_NO, l.SPECIALTY, l.OFFICE_NAME, l.APPROVE_STATUS FROM TB_MEMBER m LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE m.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT m.*, l.LAWYER_ID, l.LICENSE_NO, l.SPECIALTY, l.OFFICE_NAME, l.APPROVE_STATUS FROM TB_MEMBER m LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE m.EMAIL = #{email}

INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, MEMBER_TYPE, NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, PROVIDER, PHONE_VERIFIED, STATUS, SAVE_ID_YN, ADDRESS, DETAIL_ADDR, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{loginId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{password, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memberType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{provider,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phoneVerified, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{saveIdYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{detailAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET NAME = #{name}, PHONE = #{phone}, EMAIL = #{email}, ADDRESS = #{address}, DETAIL_ADDR = #{detailAddress}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN', WITHDRAWN_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
mapper.select: SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE NAME = #{name} AND PHONE = #{phone} AND STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT m.*, l.LAWYER_ID FROM TB_MEMBER m LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY m.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT m.*, l.LAWYER_ID FROM TB_MEMBER m LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE m.MEMBER_TYPE = #{memberType} ORDER BY m.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT * FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' AND WITHDRAWN_AT <= SYSDATE - 30
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}, EMAIL = #{email}, NAME = '알수없음', PHONE = '000-0000-0000', PASSWORD = NULL, ADDRESS = NULL, DETAIL_ADDR = NULL, PROVIDER = NULL, STATUS = 'ANONYMIZED', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

choose.when: SELECT QUESTION_ID AS "id", TITLE AS "title", TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", 0 AS "commentCount", CASE WHEN STATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN '답변완료' ELSE '대기중' END AS "status" FROM TB_QUESTION WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY QUESTION_ID DESC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT p.post_id AS "id", p.title AS "title", TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REPLY r WHERE r.ref_post_id = p.post_id) AS "commentCount", CASE WHEN p.case_type = 'MOCK' THEN '판결완료' ELSE '일반' END AS "status" FROM TB_POST p WHERE p.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND (p.STATUS IS NULL OR p.STATUS != 'DELETED')
AND (p.case_type != 'MOCK' OR p.case_type IS NULL)
AND p.case_type = 'MOCK'
ORDER BY p.post_id DESC
